text:
Lina: Morning mystery: who stole the yellow sticky notes from my desk? I had a whole pyramid.
Marco: I saw nothing. I am innocent. :detective:
Priya: I confess. I borrowed one. It was an emergency grocery list situation. Apologies for the pyramid collapse.
Lina: it was 73 sticky notes. This is not a 'one-note' crime.
Dan: evidence suggests an organized heist. We should form a Sticky Recovery Task Force. Abbrev: SRTF.
Marco: is Sticky Steve involved? He was seen near the supply closet at 9:12. :eyes:
Priya: Sticky Steve is a legend. Also guilty by association.
CoffeeBot: reminder: community supplies are for everyone. Please log supply use with `/supply use sticky 10`.
Lina: demand: return of at least 50% of the stash or face public shaming (light roast only).
Priya: offering restorative justice: I will bring a fresh roll of neon yellow and make coffee for a week.
Dan: proposal: new rule - no personal pyramids. Shared pyramid policy enacted.
Marco: vote: accept Priya's offer? react :thumbsup: yes, :thumbsdown: no, :laughing: demand ransom.
Lina: accepted. Priya wins clemency. Also, Sticky Steve remains a suspect. We will update the lore archive.
CoffeeBot: log updated: supply withdrawal by Priya recorded. Thank you for resolving the incident amicably.
Priya: note to self: buy deluxe sticky refill pack. And maybe a fake alibi for Sticky Steve. :sweat_smile:
Lina: thread closed. Long live the pyramid, in memory. :memo:
